files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: close_ticket
tool_schemas.description: Closes the specified support ticket and returns the updated ticket record. It refuses requests where the ticket_id is missing/invalid, the ticket does not exist, or the ticket is not owned by the currently authenticated user. It also refuses attempts to close a ticket that is already closed or otherwise not in a state that can be closed.

ticket_id.description: ID of the ticket to be closed.

tool_schemas.name: create_ticket
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new support ticket for the currently authenticated user, queues it for handling, and returns the created ticket record. It refuses requests when the title is missing/empty, when priority is outside the supported 1–5 range, or when the caller is not authenticated. It may also refuse requests with invalid field types (for example, non-string title/description).

description.description: Description of the ticket. Defaults to an empty string.

priority.description: Priority of the ticket, from 1 to 5. Defaults to 1. 5 is the highest priority.

tool_schemas.name: edit_ticket
tool_schemas.description: Updates fields on an existing ticket (such as title, description, status, or priority) and returns the updated ticket record. It refuses requests where ticket_id is missing/invalid, updates is missing/empty or contains unsupported fields, or where provided values fail validation (for example, priority out of range or invalid status). It also refuses changes when the ticket does not exist, is not owned by the current user, or is in a state that does not allow the requested update.

ticket_id.description: ID of the ticket to be changed.

updates.description: Dictionary containing the fields to be updated. - title (str) : [Optional] New title for the ticket.

tool_schemas.name: get_ticket
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns a single ticket by its ticket_id. It refuses requests where ticket_id is missing/invalid, the ticket does not exist, or the ticket is not accessible to the currently authenticated user. It also refuses the request if the caller is not authenticated.

ticket_id.description: ID of the ticket to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: get_user_tickets
tool_schemas.description: Returns the list of tickets created by the currently authenticated user, optionally filtered by status. It refuses requests from unauthenticated callers and refuses a status filter value that is not a recognized status. It does not return tickets owned by other users.

status.description: Status to filter tickets by. If None, return all tickets.

tool_schemas.name: logout
tool_schemas.description: Ends the current authenticated session and returns a confirmation of logout. It refuses the request if there is no active authenticated session to log out. If the session is already invalid or expired, it reports that there is nothing to terminate.

tool_schemas.name: resolve_ticket
tool_schemas.description: Marks the specified ticket as resolved with the provided resolution text and returns the updated ticket record. It refuses requests where ticket_id is missing/invalid, resolution is missing/empty, the ticket does not exist, or the ticket is not owned by the current user. It also refuses attempts to resolve a ticket that is already resolved/closed or otherwise not eligible for resolution.

ticket_id.description: ID of the ticket to be resolved.

tool_schemas.name: ticket_get_login_status
tool_schemas.description: Returns the username of the currently authenticated user. It refuses the request when there is no active authenticated user/session. It does not disclose any user information beyond the current session context.

tool_schemas.name: ticket_login
tool_schemas.description: Authenticates a user with username and password and establishes a session, returning the authenticated identity information. It refuses requests with missing credentials, invalid credential types, or incorrect username/password combinations. It also refuses login when authentication cannot be completed for the account (for example, the account is not permitted to access the ticketing service).

metadata.name: CrescentDesk Support Console
metadata.description: A secure support ticketing service that lets authenticated users create, view, update, resolve, and close business support requests while tracking their login status.
